selection_rationale: c1 most directly targets the track-mandated operational reliability question (verifier-in-the-loop iterative repair for NL→config) with a falsifiable, paired preregistered design, clear primary outcome, and feasible compute budget; reviewers rated it venue-relevant and passable after the listed repairs.
unresolved_uncertainties: External validity due to Mininet/emulator fidelity versus production devices
Adequacy of sample size/topology diversity for paired McNemar tests and subgroup analyses
Degree to which dataset vendor heterogeneity will reflect real-world config quirks
Integration operational failures (LLM↔Batfish↔emulator) masking scientific effects
Latency and operational-cost trade-offs impacting practical applicability
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Add a formal sample-size and power calculation with a pre-registered topology/vendor sampling plan.
Specify emulator configuration (Mininet/container images, routing stacks) and preregister sensitivity analyses against higher-fidelity images or vendor templates.
Predefine integration failure-handling, exhaustive logging, artifact archival, and hash procedures; describe how engineering failures will be distinguished from scientific failures.
Pre-register per-intent inclusion/exclusion criteria, exact timeout and retry policies, and fixed random seeds.
Predefine explicit criteria for when emulation-observed results override verifier-only signals and how discordant cases will be adjudicated.
